item.title: How to refer to a paper, published in electronic journal “Technical Acoustics”
item.description: When you refer to an article, published in electronic journal “Technical Acoustics” it is enough to point out address of the journal in the internet (<http://www.ejta.org>), the year of publishing and sequence number of the paper. For example, reference: A. G. Troshin. A note on calibrational technique for reusable piezoelectric film strain gauges using stepped beam with variable cross section. item.title: Reader Guide
item.description: All the articles are free. Click a selected year in "Contents" on main page (on top) to read table of content according to this year. Below each title in table of content there is a link ("read more") to abstract of the paper, references list, data on authors and other useful information including language of the paper (English or Russian).
